verdict: Meta delivered a strong lead week; Google spend needs a conversion answer.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 81 leads at an average cost of $35.37 per lead — all of them from Meta, which drove a 127% jump in leads week-over-week while cost per lead fell 59%. Google Ads ran $2,097 in spend over the same window and returned zero confirmed conversions; conversion tracking is being repaired so the true number may be under-reported, but the gap is real and Google spend has been pulled back while that is resolved. A four-day pause in ad spend across both channels through August 1–3 also interrupted momentum, and that is under review. Expect the Google conversion picture to clarify this period as offline conversion import goes live, and new creative is on track for delivery by end of August.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days, all from Meta
drop in cost per lead week-over-week, now at $35.37
spent on Google Ads this period with zero conversions recorded

watch_item.issue: Google Ads has recorded zero conversions against significant spend, and conversion tracking has a known gap.
watch_item.fix: Offline conversion import is being connected now, which will restore visibility into what that spend is actually producing.
